name: wiki-forge
description: Turn your AI agent into a knowledge compiler. Feed sources once, build a persistent cross-referenced wiki that compounds over time. Ships twelve skills (capture, ingest, query, graph, summarize, corroborate, lint, log, overview, triage, retract, init) and four subagents (ingestor, librarian, linter, curator), plus hybrid BM25+semantic search, split indices, contradiction tracking, typed cross-references, graph analysis with user-facing path/neighbor/subgraph queries, topic-coverage reports (five-section audit via two-shape retrieval), tier-classified WebSearch corroboration of the verify queue with closed-loop verify-clearing at the ingestor's takeaway gate, structured telemetry (6 JSONLs covering ingest/query/lint/overview/source-freshness/corroborate), pre-write secret scanning, content-drift polling, per-domain URL classification with stdlib raw-HTML metadata extraction (OG / JSON-LD / article:tag / arXiv citation_*) for capture-side source_tags parity with browser-clipper onramps and four-tier credibility classification (vendor/named-pub/community/denylist) for /wiki-corroborate's open-web search-and-surface flow, and a recurring scale-breakdown audit probe runner with five hard re-audit triggers for early detection of authoring-side scaling failure modes. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Default install is generic wiki-only; pass /wiki-init --dual-claude to additionally bootstrap the wiki-side identity files and SessionStart hook for a dual-Claude (wiki + clipper) project shape.
